MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas Album feels like a natural next choice because several of my past interactions were specifically with Christmas music.",
    "Andy Williams' Greatest Hits has some appeal because familiar traditional vocals fit alongside my Christmas listening, though the Christmas album is the stronger choice today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "25 Classical Favorites stretches my interest in Holiday Symphony too far: the holiday connection matters more to me than a general classical connection.",
    "Titles such as Voyage, Unforgettable, and The Very Best Of give me too little evidence of a connection to my listening for me to choose them.",
    "The Anthony Burger collection and Precious Memories do not offer a clear enough connection to the Christmas music I would choose this visit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in holiday music seems to have been extended too broadly to general collections and familiar-sounding titles.",
    "One interaction with Holiday Symphony seems to have been treated as a broader interest in classical collections, which I have not established."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated Christmas album interactions make an explicit holiday connection a stronger reason to choose than a loose musical resemblance.",
    "My Christmas interactions were clustered in November 2014, while my latest interaction was The New Old Fashioned in September 2016; that newer choice also deserves consideration.",
    "I rarely choose something without a strong connection to my interests, so a mildly appealing collection is unlikely to draw me away from the clearest match."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in Christmas music, but stretched it into broader collections that give me little reason to choose them today."
}
